text: City Planning has received a request from Crow's Theatre at 345 Carlaw Avenue and 1180 Dundas Street East, for a temporary outdoor patio associated with the Crow's Theatre Lobby Bar along the Carlaw frontage. Crow's Theatre is located within the Streetcar Crowsnest development, on the east side of Carlaw Avenue, north of Dundas Street East. The proposed outdoor patio is on private property. The site is not part of the CaféTO program. Since the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic, Crow's Theatre has remained closed due to the limitations on indoor public gatherings. The Theatre has suspended all scheduled performances and cancelled productions for 2020/2021. The proposed outdoor patio would provide an opportunity for Crow's Theatre to open their lobby bar and animate the corner of Carlaw Avenue and Dundas Street East.
